visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Long text spills out of its box
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The list is meant to stay in a 50px high box and scroll, but the text spills out below the box instead.

solution.explanation: The default overflow is visible, so content that does not fit is drawn outside the box. overflow: auto keeps it inside and adds scrolling when needed.

checks.label: The content is taller than the box
